name: Payout speed
desc: The operator's own stated withdrawal processing time, cited from its help centre or terms. A field test replaces this with the median of at least three withdrawals we time ourselves, at different sizes.

name: Bonus fairness
desc: Wagering, game weighting, max-cashout caps read line by line from the operator's own terms.

name: Crypto support
desc: Coins, withdrawal fees and minimums — read from the operator's own help pages.

name: Trust & licensing
desc: Licence and operating company read from the operator's own licence page, checked against the regulator's register where one is public.

name: Game & RTP quality
desc: The RTP version each operator actually ships, read inside its own client via RTP Watch. No public source discloses it, so it shows as not yet checked until readings exist.

name: Support
desc: Only measurable by opening tickets ourselves — three per operator, timed across time zones. Shows as not yet checked until a field test has run.
